text: It's a sunny day in Vienna, the city of music.
Amber, Teddy, Mia, Edison, Rocky and Robot Abu visit a big, beautiful garden.
Wow! Vienna is so beautiful!
Look! The flowers make a music note!
A girl rides her bike into the garden.
Hi! I'm Lena. I live in Vienna.
How do you go to the park, Lena?
I go there by bike.
Let's go to the opera house!
The kids walk to the tram stop.
How can we go there?
We can go there by tram. Look!
Ding, ding! Here comes the red tram.
At the opera house, many people play Mozart's music together.
The music is beautiful. I love Mozart!
Let's visit Mozart!
Abu pushes a button. Whoosh! They go back in time!
Now they are in Mozart's room.
Hi, Mister Mozart. We're your fans.
Oh, welcome! This is Beethoven.
What do you do in your free time?
I play the piano in my free time.
What does Mozart do in his free time?
He writes music in his free time.
Then Mozart has a question for the kids.
And you? What do you do in your free time?
I play the recorder in my free time.
What does he do in his free time?
He plays online games in his free time.
Everyone laughs.
The sun goes down. It's time to go home.
Bye, Vienna! Bye, Mozart!
What a wonderful day in Vienna!
